Our company

Experienced Hands. Honest Work.

VV Glass Fittings is a glass fitting and aluminium frame making business with more than 25 years of hands-on experience.

Most of our work comes from customers who come back and recommend us to others. We make and fit frames to your exact measurements, for homes and for businesses.
